title: Retrospective transdiagnostic analysis of laboratory, cerebrospinal fluid, EEG, MRI, FDG-PET, and other findings from the Department of Psychiatry and Psychotherapy
summary: Organic mental disorders, also known as secondary psychiatric syndromes (e.g., immune-mediated psychiatric syndromes or dementias), represent a subgroup of psychiatric illnesses. Their detection is important because it can sometimes lead to specific treatment options (e.g., immunotherapy for autoimmune psychiatric syndromes). Detection and treatment could reduce the still high rates of resistance to therapy under guideline-based treatment in psychiatry. In this retrospective project, different diagnostic findings (e.g., cerebrospinal fluid findings or MRI findings of the brain) are therefore analyzed in a transdiagnostic approach.
conditions: Patients with different mental disorders (transdiagnostic patient group)

interventions.name: Retrospective transdiagnostic analysis of multimodal diagnostic findings from a psychiatric hospital

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Day-patient treatment patients and inpatients treated from 2000 at the earliest until the end of the study (2/2026) transdiagnostically, regardless of diagnosis
Exclusion criteria:
No diagnostic findings available
